name: A Diverse Image Dataset for Bangladeshi Currency Recognition
description: A diverse computer vision dataset consisting of 5,073 background-free images of Bangladeshi Taka banknotes across nine different denominations (2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, and 1000 Taka). Images were collected with various mobile phone cameras and preprocessed with background extraction to support automated currency recognition, financial technology solutions, and denomination classification research.
